annotations.title: List a mined launch on ADEXTO

description: After the prepare_launch transaction is mined, lists the new market on adexto.xyz, in list_markets and on the x402 gateway. Reads the TrinityProjectDeployed event from the ADEXTO factory in the receipt; every value it registers comes from that event, not from the caller. Calling it again for the same transaction returns the existing listing.

chainId.description: Chain the launch transaction was sent on.

txHash.description: Hash of the mined launch transaction.

name: register_launch

agentIdentity.description: ERC-8004 binding read from the token, or null.

alreadyRegistered.description: True when it was listed before this call.

buyResource.description: x402 URL that sells the market.

code.description: On confirm_failed: error code of the registration stage.

creator.description: Creator address, from the factory event.

detail.description: Why it refused, or extra context on a successful answer.

error.description: Present only when the tool refused, as a stable code such as unknown_market. Nothing was spent.

explorerTx.description: Explorer link of the launch transaction.

launchableChains.description: On unsupported_chain: the chains that can launch.

metadataApplied.description: True when the prepare_launch metadata was applied.

registered.description: True when the market is listed.

status.description: On confirm_failed: HTTP status of the registration stage.

title: List a mined launch on ADEXTO
